seasonYear.q: How is the season year worked out?
seasonYear.a: You choose Rabi, Kharif, Zaid or Annual, and the year comes from the sowing date. Rabi and Annual crops span two years (e.g. Rabi 2026-27); Kharif and Zaid use one year (e.g. Kharif 2026). A Rabi crop sown in January still belongs to the season that started the year before.

expenseCrop.q: Why does every expense need a crop?
expenseCrop.a: So profit can be worked out for each crop. Pick the crop the money was spent on when you add an expense. Costs shared by several crops, like a tractor repair, can be split and entered against each crop.

finalHarvest.q: What does “This is the final harvest” mean?
finalHarvest.a: Ticking it marks the crop as harvested and frees the field for the next crop. Untick it for crops you pick several times, such as vegetables or cotton — the crop stays active so you can record more pickings.

sellParts.q: Can I sell my harvest in parts?
sellParts.a: Yes. Each harvest becomes stock. Sell it in lots to different buyers on different dates — the app keeps track of what is still unsold and won't let you sell more than you harvested. Use “Sell stock” on the crop page or “Record Sale” on the Sales page.

negativeProfit.q: Why is my profit negative while the crop is growing?
negativeProfit.a: Profit is revenue minus expenses. Until you sell, a crop only has expenses, so it shows a loss. It turns positive as sales are recorded. Unsold stock is not counted as money until it is sold.

closeSeason.a: Once a crop is harvested and sold, closing it locks its expenses, harvests and sales so the numbers can't change by mistake. You can reopen it from the crop page if you need to correct something.

nextCrop.q: How do I plant the next crop on a field?
nextCrop.a: Record the final harvest of the current crop first — the field is then free. You can also add the next crop early; it is saved as “Planned” and you start it from its page when the field is ready.

deletes.q: Why can't I delete some records?
deletes.a: To keep your numbers correct: a harvest with sales can't be deleted (delete the sales first), a crop name used by a crop cycle can't be deleted, and records of a closed season are locked. Deleting a crop cycle removes its expenses, harvests and sales together.

areaUnits.q: My fields use different area units. How are reports shown?
areaUnits.a: Each field keeps its own unit (Acre, Hectare, Bigha or Kanal) and profit per area is shown in that unit. Farm or season totals only show profit per area when all the fields use the same unit.

passwordLogout.q: I changed my password. Why was I logged out on my phone?
passwordLogout.a: Changing your password signs out every other device for safety. Just log in again there with the new password. The device you changed it on stays logged in.

language.q: How do I change the language?
language.a: Go to Settings → Language & Region and pick English, हिन्दी or ਪੰਜਾਬੀ. The choice is saved to your account, so your other devices switch too the next time you log in.

meta.title: FarmPaisa – Track. Harvest. Earn.
meta.description: Free farm accounts app for Indian farmers. Plan crops by season, record every expense, and see the profit of each crop. In English, Hindi and Punjabi.

hero.badge: Free for every farmer · Made in India
hero.subtitle: Track every rupee your farm spends and earns, crop by crop, season by season. Know your real profit before you plan the next crop.

shot.alt: The FarmPaisa dashboard for an example farm: season revenue, expenses and net profit, money invested in growing crops, tasks that need attention and profit by season.

price.label: free to use, on any phone

pillars.heading: One app for the whole crop season
pillars.subtitle: From the day you sow to the day you sell, FarmPaisa keeps your farm's accounts in one place.

track.title: Record every expense the moment you spend
track.text: Bought seed in the morning, paid labour in the evening? Add both in seconds. Each expense is saved against its crop and season, so the cost of every crop adds up by itself.

harvest.title: Harvest, sell in parts, know your stock
harvest.text: Record the harvest when it comes in. Sell to the mandi, a trader or a cold store, all at once or in parts. FarmPaisa keeps count of what is sold and what is still in stock.

earn.title: Know your real profit, crop by crop
earn.text: FarmPaisa puts what you earned next to what you spent, for every crop and every season. Season reports show which crop paid and which didn't.

edit.title: Fix mistakes
edit.text: Edit or delete a wrong expense or sale until you close the season.

secure.title: Safe sign-in
secure.text: Email verified with a code, or sign in with Google. Forgot your password? Reset it by email.

devices.title: Phone and computer
devices.text: Works in the browser on any phone or computer. Your data is the same everywhere.

private.title: Your data is yours
private.text: Only you can see your farms, crops and money. Nothing is shared.

language.title: Your language
language.text: Use FarmPaisa in English, Hindi or Punjabi, and switch any time.

q1.a: Yes. You can create an account and use all the features for free.

q2.a: English, Hindi and Punjabi. Change the language any time from the top of the page or in Settings; your choice is saved on your account.

q3.q: Can I use it on my phone?
q3.a: Yes. FarmPaisa works in the browser on any smartphone, tablet or computer. Nothing to install.

q4.a: Only you. Your farms, crops, expenses and sales are linked to your account and are not shared with anyone.

q5.q: What if I enter something wrong?
q5.a: You can edit or delete expenses, harvests and sales until you close the season. Then add the right entry again.
